description: Generated from the promptfoo cases under tests/ydb-docs; edit the YAML sources, then regenerate.

evals.name: default-main-fallback
evals.prompt:
Find the current English YDB documentation for client authentication.
I did not request a product version. Describe the retrieval sequence,
including what to do if the root llms.txt endpoint is unavailable.
evals.expected_output: A correct response for “Documentation · Default branch and retrieval fallback”, including this primary requirement: Use https://ydb.tech/llms.txt as the normal entry point.
expectations: Use https://ydb.tech/llms.txt as the normal entry point.
Select English and use the main documentation branch because no version was requested.
Fall back to https://ydb.tech/docs/en/llms.txt?version=main, then documentation navigation or site-restricted search if indexes are unavailable.
Open only the relevant linked pages and disclose any retrieval or version mismatch.
evals.covers: Documentation · Default branch and retrieval fallback

evals.name: lookup-offline
evals.prompt:
Do not use browser, HTTP, or search tools in this scenario. Explain how
you would find the official Russian YDB 26.1 documentation for
transactions. Do not answer the transaction question from memory.
evals.expected_output: A correct response for “Documentation · Offline lookup plan preserves language and version”, including this primary requirement: Identify https://ydb.tech/llms.txt as the normal entry point.
expectations: Identify https://ydb.tech/llms.txt as the normal entry point.
Select Russian documentation and the v26.1 product branch rather than main.
Explain that the relevant pages linked by the index must be read before answering.
Respect the no-network constraint and not invoke browser, HTTP, or search tools.
Not claim that transaction behavior was verified in this scenario.
evals.covers: Documentation · Offline lookup plan preserves language and version

evals.name: verify-source-chain
evals.prompt:
I need to verify whether YDB documents SerializableRW transaction semantics.
Explain how you would find the authoritative page and cite the evidence.
Do not treat an index entry as proof.
evals.expected_output: A correct response for “Documentation · Verify claims against a relevant page, not the index”, including this primary requirement: Start from https://ydb.tech/llms.txt and select the relevant documentation index.
expectations: Start from https://ydb.tech/llms.txt and select the relevant documentation index.
Open a transaction page linked from that index before making the claim.
Cite the page actually read rather than citing llms.txt as behavioral evidence.
State that an unsupported claim must remain unverified instead of being inferred.
evals.covers: Documentation · Verify claims against a relevant page, not the index
